title: W1 fix inert in browsers: no client code ever populates the review submit's _focus_seconds, so focus_seconds_reported is still always 0 (still present since r1)
detail: reference_form.js writes [data-focus-seconds] only inside per-question onSubmit and initBrowser bails on the review page (no reference-form-page testid, no .ref-question), so the review submit natively posts the static '0'; the new tests inject 240 directly — production still always 0.
recommended_fix: Add a submit listener that sets the review form's _focus_seconds from the live clock (or carry the accumulated seconds across the review navigation), and pin it in the JS wiring test — otherwise the field stays 0 for every real referee.
